name: CLI Control Plane
objective: Expose compact local control commands for governed operations using prompt runtime, cache summaries, restart gate and flywheel decisions.
why_now: P14-P17 implemented prompt frames, cache ledger, restart gate, benchmark, and flywheel. P18 should surface these capabilities through a practical CLI control interface.
success_conditions: CLI command map for runtime reports implemented
prompt frame and cache summaries inspectable via CLI
restart gate and benchmark invocable via CLI
